params.name: league.medical.daysPerGameWeek
params.constrainedBy: Catalogue games missed become days at one game per week (C2 weekly schedule). Test "catalogue draw"

params.name: league.medical.daysPerMonth
params.constrainedBy: Mean Gregorian month (365.2425 / 12), unit conversion for month-based catalogue rows and surgery dates. Test "shutdown and surgery timing"

params.name: league.medical.recoveryTailFactor
params.constrainedBy: Catalogue rows give p25 and p75 only; the tails reach this many half-IQRs beyond them. Test "catalogue draw"

params.name: league.medical.minRecoveryDays
params.constrainedBy: Floor on a drawn recovery. Test "catalogue draw"

params.name: league.medical.iqrMid
params.constrainedBy: Quantile of the catalogue centre value (median). Test "catalogue draw"

params.name: league.medical.iqrLow
params.constrainedBy: Quantile of the catalogue low value when its basis is the interquartile range (p25). Test "catalogue draw"

params.name: league.medical.clearWithLimitsAt
params.constrainedBy: Share of recovery the physician believes done before "cleared with limits". Test "authority: clearance states"

params.name: league.medical.clearAt
params.constrainedBy: Share of recovery the physician believes done before "cleared". Test "authority: clearance states"

params.name: league.medical.cautionShift
params.constrainedBy: A fully cautious physician needs this much more believed recovery (clears later, fewer re-injuries). Test "authority: cautious physician clears later"

params.name: league.medical.snapCapShare
params.constrainedBy: Snap cap while cleared with limits. Test "authority: limits"

params.name: league.medical.objectionNotCleared
params.constrainedBy: Chance of a written objection (L8.2.2) when a not-cleared player is used: "likely". Test "authority: use against clearance"

params.name: league.medical.objectionWithLimits
params.constrainedBy: Chance of a written objection when a player is used past his limits. Test "authority: use against clearance"

params.name: league.medical.refusalBase
params.constrainedBy: Base chance a player refuses to play when not cleared. Test "authority: refusal"

params.name: league.medical.refusalCautionWeight
params.constrainedBy: Added refusal chance at zero toughness. Test "authority: refusal"

params.name: league.medical.refusalDistrustWeight
params.constrainedBy: Added refusal chance at zero trust in the coach. Test "authority: refusal"

params.name: league.medical.sidelineBase
params.constrainedBy: Sideline read correct with 0.6 + 0.3 x accuracy. Test "estimate: sideline read"

params.name: league.medical.sidelineSlope
params.constrainedBy: As above. Test "estimate: sideline read"

params.name: league.medical.imagingLowMin
params.constrainedBy: Imaging factor range at low accuracy, 0.7 to 1.4. Test "estimate: imaging factor"

params.name: league.medical.imagingLowMax
params.constrainedBy: As above. Test "estimate: imaging factor"

params.name: league.medical.imagingHighMin
params.constrainedBy: Imaging factor range at high accuracy, 0.85 to 1.2. Test "estimate: imaging factor"

params.name: league.medical.imagingHighMax
params.constrainedBy: As above. Test "estimate: imaging factor"

params.name: league.medical.imagingDelayDays
params.constrainedBy: Imaging the next day for most injuries. Test "estimate: imaging timing"

params.name: league.medical.majorImagingDelayDays
params.constrainedBy: Same night for suspected major injuries. Test "estimate: imaging timing"

params.name: league.medical.rangeStartHalfWidth
params.constrainedBy: Shown range plus or minus 35 percent at first. Test "estimate: range narrows"

params.name: league.medical.rangeEndHalfWidth
params.constrainedBy: Shrinks linearly to plus or minus 10 percent. Test "estimate: range narrows"

params.name: league.medical.rangeNarrowedAt
params.constrainedBy: Reached by the last third of recovery. Test "estimate: range narrows"

params.name: league.medical.estimateLearnFloor
params.constrainedBy: Share of the imaging error left as recovery proceeds (1 = the factor is drawn once and kept, as D11.3.2 reads). At 1 the true return date sits inside the shown range 82 percent of the time (target 75 to 85). Test "estimate: coverage 75 to 85 percent"

params.name: league.medical.setbackChance
params.constrainedBy: Setback chance per injury, 5 to 15 percent starting values; one value until the catalogue carries one per type. Test "estimate: setbacks"

params.name: league.medical.setbackAddedShare
params.constrainedBy: A setback adds this share of the original recovery. Test "estimate: setbacks"

params.name: league.medical.minorMaxDays
params.constrainedBy: Severity classes for the sideline read: minor up to this many days. Test "estimate: sideline read"

params.name: league.medical.moderateMaxDays
params.constrainedBy: Moderate up to this many days. Test "estimate: sideline read"

params.name: league.medical.majorMaxDays
params.constrainedBy: Major up to this many days, season-ending beyond. Test "estimate: sideline read"

params.name: league.medical.agreeBase
params.constrainedBy: Chance a player agrees to "give me a quarter" with zero toughness, trust and no contract year. Test "pressure: player agrees"

params.name: league.medical.agreeToughnessWeight
params.constrainedBy: Added at full toughness. Test "pressure: player agrees"

params.name: league.medical.agreeTrustWeight
params.constrainedBy: Added at full trust. Test "pressure: player agrees"

params.name: league.medical.agreeContractYearBonus
params.constrainedBy: Added in a contract year. Test "pressure: player agrees"

params.name: league.medical.pressureLimitsAdvance
params.constrainedBy: Leaning on the doctors lowers the believed-recovery bar for "cleared with limits" by this much (never for concussion or structural injuries). Test "pressure: doctors"

params.name: league.medical.medicalTrustCost
params.constrainedBy: Medical staff trust in the coach lost per use of pressure. Test "pressure: costs"

params.name: league.medical.playerTrustCostBadOutcome
params.constrainedBy: Player trust lost when a pressured return goes wrong. Test "pressure: costs"

params.name: league.medical.roomTrustCostBadOutcome
params.constrainedBy: Room trust lost when a pressured return goes wrong. Test "pressure: costs"

params.name: league.medical.concussionDetection
params.constrainedBy: A true concussion is found at the evaluation with probability 0.9 (Assumption in the leaf). Test "concussion: evaluation"

params.name: league.medical.followUpFindsMissed
params.constrainedBy: The next-day follow-up exam finds a concussion the evaluation missed. Test "concussion: follow-up exam"

params.name: league.medical.priorConcussionLengthen
params.constrainedBy: Each prior concussion in the last 12 months lengthens symptom time by 30 percent. Test "concussion: prior concussions"

params.name: league.medical.priorConcussionWindowDays
params.constrainedBy: "In the last 12 months". Test "concussion: prior concussions"

params.name: league.medical.stepFailChance
params.constrainedBy: Symptoms return during a step (one step back). Test "concussion: calibration"

params.name: league.medical.reinjuryDayOne
params.constrainedBy: Re-injury multiplier for the same region on the first day cleared. Test "return: re-injury curve"

params.name: league.medical.reinjuryAfterDecay
params.constrainedBy: Decays to 1.3 over 6 weeks. Test "return: re-injury curve"

params.name: league.medical.reinjuryDecayDays
params.constrainedBy: 6 weeks. Test "return: re-injury curve"

params.name: league.medical.reinjurySecondDecayDays
params.constrainedBy: From 1.3 to the permanent value over this many more days. Test "return: re-injury curve"

params.name: league.medical.reinjuryPermanentSoftTissue
params.constrainedBy: Permanent multiplier for soft-tissue types. Test "return: re-injury curve"

params.name: league.medical.reinjuryPermanentOther
params.constrainedBy: Other types return to no added risk. Test "return: re-injury curve"

params.name: league.medical.earlyReturnMultiplier
params.constrainedBy: Returning before the true recovery point multiplies the risk again by 1.5. Test "return: early return"

params.name: league.medical.returnSpeedPenalty
params.constrainedBy: Soft tissue: top speed and acceleration minus 3 percent on clearance. Test "return: physical penalty"

params.name: league.medical.returnPenaltyDays
params.constrainedBy: Decays to zero over 3 weeks of full practice. Test "return: physical penalty"

params.name: league.medical.majorReturnLevel
params.constrainedBy: Major injuries: 70 percent of the new level at return. Test "return: major injury curve"

params.name: league.medical.toughnessMaxReduction
params.constrainedBy: Toughness reduces the play-through penalty by up to one third. Test "playing hurt: penalties"

params.name: league.medical.injectionHiddenShare
params.constrainedBy: An injection hides up to half of the play-through penalty for that game. Test "playing hurt: injection"

params.name: league.medical.hideBase
params.constrainedBy: Chance a player hides a minor injury at zero toughness. Test "playing hurt: hidden injury"

params.name: league.medical.hideToughnessWeight
params.constrainedBy: Added at full toughness. Test "playing hurt: hidden injury"

params.name: league.medical.hiddenDailyDiscovery
params.constrainedBy: Daily chance the staff finds a hidden injury; 1 - 0.89^21 = 0.91 meets "revealed within 3 weeks in 90 percent". Test "playing hurt: hidden injury found within 3 weeks"

params.name: league.medical.hiddenRevealWindowDays
params.constrainedBy: The 3-week window of the acceptance line. Test "playing hurt: hidden injury found within 3 weeks"

params.name: league.medical.nonOpWorsenPerGame
params.constrainedBy: Non-operative path: 4 percent chance of worsening per game played. Test "shutdown and surgery timing"

params.name: league.medical.choiceHealthWeight
params.constrainedBy: Player surgery choice: own health always the largest weight. Test "shutdown: contract-year players play through more"

params.name: league.medical.choiceContractYearWeight
params.constrainedBy: Contract year pulls toward playing. Test "shutdown: contract-year players play through more"

params.name: league.medical.choiceGuaranteedWeight
params.constrainedBy: Guaranteed money pulls toward surgery. Test "shutdown: contract-year players play through more"

params.name: league.medical.choiceToughnessWeight
params.constrainedBy: Toughness pulls toward playing. Test "shutdown: contract-year players play through more"

params.name: league.medical.choiceCoachWeight
params.constrainedBy: The coach's recommendation scaled by trust. Test "shutdown: coach request"

params.name: league.medical.choiceNoise
params.constrainedBy: Spread of the player's own judgment. Test "shutdown: contract-year players play through more"

params.name: league.medical.statusWarnGap
params.constrainedBy: The staff warns when a filed status's measured play rate is this far from the staff estimate. Test "report: staff warning"
